messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to decide SLA + pin policy for a new model family (fast-translate-v3). Sales has three customers asking for a guaranteed version pin for 90 days plus perf SLAs. Can we offer that without Dedicated?
Devon: Hard 90d pin without reserved capacity is risky. We can do a paid reserved capacity offering or a soft-pin with strong monitoring + credits.
Alejandro: What perf numbers are they asking for specifically? p50/p95/throughput?
Maya: They want p95 < 300ms for ~512-token generates and 99.9% availability. Also will run batch embeddings off-peak. They want explicit migration windows and rollback guarantees.
Lina: From product side, three discrete options:
- A) Soft-pin: default catalog pin + 30d grace window, automatic migration with notice
- B) Paid-pin: capacity reservation for 90d, customer pays premium, we guarantee pin + migration window
- C) Canary opt-in: client-run canary then opt-in for longer pin after 2 successful canaries
We need clear launch criteria and benchmarks for each.
Devon: Cost note — reserving capacity for three customers will increase baseline infra costs. Need infra to estimate delta. Also quantization profile differences matter for latency.
ops-bot: Bench scoring suggestion: `score = 0.5 * latency_norm + 0.3 * quality_norm + 0.2 * stability_norm`
ops-bot: GA threshold idea: score >= 0.78 and no regression > 2% on customer-critical prompts.
Maya: Proposal: ship Paid-pin as an add-on behind Dedicated or Dedicated Lite. SLA: p95 < 350ms, 99.95% uptime, migration notice = 10 business days, 90d pin as billable option. Soft-pin (A) stays free but with 30d grace.
Alejandro: For launch gating we should require: 3 customer canaries OR 1 large + 2 internal canaries, full bench suite (perf, 10 prompt regressions, embedding consistency), and a rollback playbook.
Devon: Action items: 1) Eng (Devon + infra) to provide cost delta and latency tradeoffs. 2) Product (Maya + Lina) to draft pricing & contract addendum. 3) CS (Alejandro) to collect customer traffic patterns & acceptance criteria.
Maya: Timeline: aim to have a draft offer and bench spec by EOW next sprint. Must not enable hard pins until telemetry + regression alerts are on.
Lina: I'll start the spec doc and include the bench matrix. tagging @Alejandro for dataset examples.
Alejandro: I'll upload sample datasets to /mnt/onboard/pin-canary and share links shortly. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — want a short sync Thurs after cost estimates. If infra flags capacity concerns we fallback to paid-pin + canary only.
Devon: ack. I'll ping infra for quota numbers and a quick cost model.
ops-bot: Example config for a paid-pin canary (dev preview):
```
canary_config:
  mode: reserved
  duration_days: 14
  traffic_split: 5%
```
Alejandro: +1 on canary config, also recommend adding an "auto-unpin" safety after 90d unless renewed.
Lina: Noted. I'll add the auto-unpin policy and a customer opt-in renewal workflow.
Maya: Cool — saving notes to the spec. Will create a formal thread in roadmap once we have the cost and bench numbers.
